strings.desc_atlas: Interactive 3D human body explorer with rotation, zoom, and layer controls.
strings.desc_systems: The 10 core anatomical systems stored locally in the offline IndexedDB database.
strings.desc_anatomy_lab: Isolation, layer visibility, and exploded view dissection tools.
strings.desc_physiology_lab: Educational simulations for heart, lungs, digestive tract, muscles, and joints.
strings.desc_imaging_lab: Local CT and MRI slice viewer supporting Axial, Coronal, and Sagittal planes.
strings.desc_academy: Bilingual educational library for systems, organs, and medical terminology.
strings.desc_quiz: Interactive quiz engine with MCQ, 3D identification, and local progress tracking.
strings.desc_settings: Manage app language, mobile performance profile, and open-source licenses.
strings.module_honesty_note: This section shell is established in Phase 2. Its interactive engine and verified medical content will be activated in its dedicated phase without dummy data.
strings.setting_language_desc: Switch interface language and apply RTL/LTR layout immediately.
strings.setting_quality_desc: Balances visual quality and memory usage for mid-range phones.
strings.setting_licenses_desc: Verified sources and licenses of all free libraries and assets used.
